Ynet/Yedioth 28 Mar 2025 reconstructs the 8 May 2022 assessment from participants, senior security sources and documents; Ynet 9 Dec 2025 reports senior-officer testimony and operational summaries presented to the Turgeman review that independently corroborate the May 2022 preventive initiative while preserving conflicting accounts of origin/rejection rationale. The same dual Sinwar-Deif targeting plan was later presented to Netanyahu after the 29 Dec 2022 government change.
gaps: Retrospective evidence; original minutes/recording are not public. Do not claim Bennett's exact wording was relayed to Netanyahu. This is an older-warning-chain event, not a prediction of the Oct. 7 operational plan/date/routes/force size.
